news.title: Opinion: MyChart said I could opt out of sharing my health data. Figuring out how was maddening
news.summary: Want to opt out of sharing your personal health data? You may need a notary, writes Alex Rosenblat.

news.summary: The CEO of Compass Pathways said the company, whose psychedelic therapy is set for regulatory review this year, is prepared to “go slow before we go fast.”

news.title: Epic teams up with Amazon Pharmacy, Eli Lilly and Mark Cuban to launch prescription drug pricing tool
news.summary: Epic is bringing pharmacy price shopping directly into the doctor's office and the prescribing workflow.

news.summary: The pair filed Certificate of Needs with the state to build two hospitals comprising 200 beds in fast-growing North Carolina's Mecklenburg County.

news.title: Drugmakers, PhRMA seek to intervene in hospitals' 340B rebate challenge
news.summary: The American Hospital Association and others have launched a legal rematch with the federal government over the second iteration of a pilot program swapping out safety-net hospitals’ upfront drug discounts for after-the-fact rebates.

news.title: Catching up with Blue Shield of California CEO Mike Stuart one year in
news.summary: In August 2025, Blue Shield of California named Mike Stuart as its CEO. Now, a year later, he's reflecting on months of work toward addressing affordability, member access and the patient journey.

news.title: Voice AI startup careCycle rolls out free plan comparison tool for Medicare beneficiaries
news.summary: The tool is free to use, takes no payments from payers or commissions and does not sell or share personal information. It surfaces yearly cost estimates and shows nearby plans that keep a patient's doctors in-network.

news.title: Clasp launches national marketplace for loan-linked hiring
news.summary: Healthcare students can use the Clasp Marketplace to compare jobs by what each one pays toward their student loans, plus salaries. In order to post a job, an employer must commit money toward a student’s debt.

news.title: Millie to open first of several joint clinics with El Camino Health in the Bay Area
news.summary: The clinic will combine Millie’s midwifery care model with El Camino’s labor and delivery services and broader specialist network. The goal is to offer an integrated pregnancy, birth and postpartum experience.

news.title: Chutes & Ladders—Inspira Health outlines leadership transition; Joint Commission names COO
news.summary: Welcome to this week's Chutes & Ladders, our roundup of hirings, firings and retirings throughout the industry. Please submit the good news—or the bad—from your shop, and we will feature it here at the end of each week.

news.title: Elevance Health Foundation launched a prize program for patient safety initiatives. Here's why
news.summary: The Elevance Health Foundation has launched a new prize program aimed at supporting solutions aimed at improving patient safety, with the first crop of winners targeting challenges like health literacy, fall prevention and medication errors.

news.title: American Academy of Family Physicians joins physician social network Roon
news.summary: AAFP members will be able to use the platform to connect with peers as part of the collaboration.

news.title: As prior auth becomes an AI ‘arms race,’ Otter Health raises $8M for a different approach
news.summary: The company built an AI-powered real-time clinical quality platform to better manage healthcare utilization by influencing care decisions rather than requiring clinicians to get permission for them.

news.title: OrbiMed’s largest-ever Asian fund contributes to $3B war chest
news.summary: OrbiMed has raised $3 billion to place a fresh round of bets on biotechs and life sciences companies in the U.S., Europe and Asia.

news.title: Osivax focuses on combo strategy for flu vaccine after phase 2 fail
news.summary: Osivax has been forced to narrow the strategy for its influenza vaccine after the shot failed a phase 2b study.

news.title: AstraZeneca inks $1.5B insitro deal for AI-enabled target discovery of liver, heart disease drugs
news.summary: AstraZeneca is paying insitro $40 million upfront to find novel drug targets for liver and heart diseases using artificial intelligence.

news.title: Rebranded Galapagos finally finds buyer for unwanted cell therapy pipeline
news.summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics—the new name for Belgium’s Galapagos Therapeutics—has found a buyer for its unwanted cell therapy pipeline.

news.title: Iambic goes public with $150M IPO to accelerate clinical development of oncology pipeline
news.summary: Iambic Therapeutics’ IPO came in dead on target, bringing in $150 million for the AI biotech to fuel the clinical development of its oncology pipeline.

news.title: Vanda pauses social anxiety program after ex-Novartis asset flunks phase 3 study
news.summary: A phase 3 trial of Vanda Pharmaceuticals’ social anxiety disorder drug candidate has missed its primary endpoint, prompting the company to put the program on hold.

news.title: Why OMass’ $310M series C marks ‘fantastic milestone’ on journey to become ‘Britain’s Big Biotech’
news.summary: When Fierce last caught up with OMass Therapeutics’ CEO Ros Deegan, it was hard not to be impressed by the company’s ambition.

news.title: IQVIA, Veeva expand on existing partnership for speedier clinical trials
news.summary: Clinical research giant IQVIA and cloud system provider Veeva Systems have expanded their partnership to further increase trial speed and efficiency.

news.title: Merck KGaA spinout iOnctura touts PI3K delta inhibitor in metastatic eye cancer
news.summary: iOnctura’s PI3K delta inhibitor shows promise in phase 1 study in patients with mostly pre-treated metastatic melanoma.

news.title: Verastem CEO claims RAS drug has 'set a new benchmark' for tricky cancer in early readout
news.summary: Verastem Oncology's decision to refocus its R&D efforts on its KRAS inhibitor appears to be paying off, at least based on initial data from a phase 1/2 trial.

news.title: Deep-pocketed Verdiva axes GLP-1 switching trial over ‘market evolution’
news.summary: Verdiva Bio has scrapped a phase 2 trial of its once-weekly oral GLP-1 drug candidate VRB-101, pulling the plug the year after launching with $410 million.

news.title: Biomea posts phase 1 data to pitch oral GLP-1 to potential partners, but investors appear unconvinced
news.summary: Biomea Fusion has shared phase 1 data on its oral GLP-1 prospect, shedding light on a small molecule designed to balance efficacy and gastrointestinal tolerability. Management hailed the data as a launchpad for talks with potential partners, but investors drove down the share price of the cash-strapped biotech.

papers.title: InfoVis: Unified Slide Image Generation and Editing
papers.summary: Generating and editing presentation slides requires models to combine accurate text rendering, instruction following, visual grounding, aesthetic design, and precise editing within one canvas. Existing work covers only subsets of these capabilities and lacks large-scale slide-native supervision and diagnostic evaluation. We formulate four slide-centric tasks and build a scalable data engine with over 13M continual-pretraining records and 1.9M supervised fine-tuning records. papers.title: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
papers.summary: With the rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), evaluating their video understanding capabilities has become increasingly important. Existing video understanding benchmarks cover only part of the evaluation dimensions, limiting systematic diagnosis of omni-modal video understanding. We introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding. papers.title: Lluna: Collaborative Unimodal Models for Missing-Modality Inference
papers.summary: Pretrained unimodal models offer a flexible route to multimodal prediction through collaboration, but this collaboration can become less accurate than a surviving unimodal model when modalities are missing. We study this setting using fixed surviving-model anchors and find that collaborative gains can weaken or reverse as inputs disappear, even when the anchor's own input is unchanged.
